description: Kept the plot on the nail and would not pad the messenger.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Set Sam on the breath, not on the word.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Called the afternoon two thousand a house, and counted them as timber.
name: James Burbage

description: Spoke the messenger's four words in black, slowly.
name: John Sincler

description: Named the gallery's fifty-two shillings and the crowd that paid them.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Asked for the length of the boards and left the hush for the afternoon.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Sang the cuckoo clear and stopped when he was told once more was enough.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Refused to turn her stair or the house into a receipt.
name: William Shakespeare
